newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Banks in Brazil aid program roll over debts - report.
newsitem.headline: Banks in Brazil aid program roll over debts - report.

text.p: Six loans to banks benefitting from the Brazilian government's generous Proer merger aid program expired in August without being repaid, Folha de Sao Paulo newspaper said.
The loans, totalling 4.918 billion reais, were made to Banco Economico, Banorte and Banco Mercantil banks, the paper said.
Folha, quoting a government spokesman, said the Central Bank extended the repayment terms for the loans by 90 days.
It added Central Bank officials downplayed the significance of the expiry of original terms, saying the program allows extensions.
The Proer program, created last year to help ailing banks merge with healthy financial institutions, is due to expire at the end of 1996.
